Edifice Travels – A unit of Edifice Travel Solutions LLP is a travel company based out of New Delhi in India, specializing in experiential travel tours for travel enthusiasts/ tourists across the world. We also manage conferences for various institutions and companies across the world and manage them in India, Dubai, Colombo and Singapore.
At Edifice Travels, we are committed to making this a reality for all our travelers through our unique and bespoke theme tours specially designed to acquaint them with the age- old paradigms of Indian culture, the deepest secrets of this mystical land and its enchanting beauty that awakens inspiration. We also aim to promote conscious and responsible tourism through our tours.
